verdicts.decision_note: The client explicitly requests rendering the book cover on the landing page, establishing a persistent frontend presentation behavior.
The client changes the cover placement to the landing-page hero and explicitly requests integration with the headline.
Target-specific implementation claim: the immediately preceding enumerated changes explicitly include adding the cover to the hero.

The client replaces hero-specific integration with flexible landing-page placement and establishes concrete size, cropping, and non-overlap UI constraints; the removed hero_integration key existed before this change.
First concrete post-claim failure: the enlarged cover made the hero messy and overlapped the View Dashboard control.
The client establishes the concrete UI acceptance condition that the entire cover must remain visible without cutoff.
First concrete cutoff failure: the rendered book cover was not fully visible, a distinct failure from the earlier control overlap.
The client explicitly sets the rendered cover size back to small while retaining the full-visibility requirement.
Post-edit persistence and size regression: the cover had been enlarged by an edit but remained cut off.
Distinct partial post-fix result: full visibility was achieved, but the cover still failed the requested small-size presentation constraint.
